title: How to Download Pinterest Videos and Photos to Your Gallery
description: How to download Pinterest videos and photos to your phone gallery or laptop for free, with no app and no login. Follow the easy steps here.
body:
Ever found a recipe video, a decor idea or a short tutorial on Pinterest and wanted to watch it again without internet? Pinterest's save feature puts a Pin on a board inside the app, so the file never actually lands in your phone's gallery. In this article you'll learn how to download Pinterest videos and Pinterest photos to your gallery easily, for free, with no extra app and no login.

The tool we'll use is I Need Save, a web-based downloader you can open straight from the browser on your phone or laptop. Besides Pinterest, I Need Save also works with public posts from TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter) and several other platforms.

What you'll need

  • The link of the Pin you want to save. Make sure the Pin is public.
  • Any browser, such as Chrome on Android or Safari on iPhone.
  • A reasonably stable internet connection, especially for longer videos.

You don't need to create an account on I Need Save or install any app.

How to download Pinterest videos on your phone

The steps are the same on Android and iPhone:

  1. Open the Pinterest app and find the video Pin you want.
  2. Tap the Share button, then choose Copy link.
  3. Open your browser and go to the I Need Save downloader page.
  4. Paste the link into the box, or simply tap the Paste button.
  5. Press Download and wait a moment for the file options to appear.
  6. Choose the option you want, for example a video in a specific quality.

If the button changes to Preparing…, don't close the page yet. It means the video is being processed, for example the video and audio are being joined or a stream is being converted to MP4. Once that's done, the download starts automatically.

How to save Pinterest photos

For image Pins, it works almost the same way. Copy the Pin link, paste it into I Need Save, then press Download. In the list of options, choose Photo or Thumbnail. This option is also handy if you only need the cover image of a video Pin, for example as a personal design reference.

Choosing the right video quality

After pressing Download, you'll usually see several quality options such as 360p, 720p or 1080p. What appears depends on the original video, so not every Pin has a 1080p option.

  • 360p is a good fit when your data is limited or your phone storage is almost full.
  • 720p is a balanced choice between sharpness and file size.
  • 1080p is the sharpest, great for watching on a big screen.

You can read a fuller explanation in our article on the difference between 360p, 720p and 1080p video quality.

Besides video, there's also an Audio option. You can grab the audio in original quality, or as a 192 kbps MP3 converted from the video. Handy if all you're after is a Pin's background music.

Where are Pinterest files saved?

The file location depends on the device you're using:

  • Android and computer: files go to the Downloads folder. The Gallery app may take a moment before showing them.
  • iPhone and iPad (Safari): files go to the Files app → Downloads. To get a video into the Photos app, open it in Files, tap Share, then choose Save Video.

Still can't find your file? Follow our guide on where downloaded files are saved on Android and iPhone.

Files are sent directly from Pinterest to your device and are not stored on the I Need Save server. So keep important files somewhere you can easily find them again.

If a Pinterest download fails

A few things can make the process fail:

  • The Pin comes from a private account or can only be viewed after logging in.
  • The content is restricted to certain regions.
  • The pasted link is incomplete or wasn't copied correctly.

Try copying the link again straight from the Share button, then repeat the process. Keep in mind that private content, content that requires a login and region-restricted content simply can't be downloaded.

Use it responsibly

Many Pins contain other people's work, such as photos, illustrations or videos made by creators. Only download for personal use, for example to keep as a reference or to watch offline. If you want to repost something, ask the owner for permission first and give credit.

Frequently asked questions

Is downloading Pinterest videos with I Need Save free?

Yes, it's free. Just open the site in your browser, with no app and no login.

Can I use it on a laptop?

Yes. Open the Pin in your laptop's browser, copy its link, then paste it into I Need Save. The file will go to your Downloads folder.

Why doesn't the video show up in my gallery right away?

On Android, the Gallery sometimes needs a moment to refresh its list of files. On iPhone, you first need to save the video from the Files app to Photos using the Share menu.
